public_profile.summary: Convective Capital 是一家聚焦灾害韧性与实体世界风险的投资机构。官网称其投资硬件、软件和金融服务；策略从野火防范延伸到电网、林业、保险、供应链与基础设施等韧性主题。

facts.label: 第二期基金披露
facts.value: 创始人于 2026-05-21 宣布 Fund II 募集 8,500 万美元，计划投资约 18 家公司，阶段覆盖 pre-seed、seed 和 Series A；该金额为基金募集规模，不是对单家公司的出资。

facts.label: 行业网络与组合支持
facts.value: 机构称 Updraft 韧性实践者网络超过 10,000 人，并已为组合公司带来超过 1 亿美元收入；均为机构自报口径。

facts.label: 团队履历
value: Bill Clerico — 创始人、管理合伙人；此前共同创办并担任 WePay CEO，该公司于 2017 年被 JPMorgan Chase 收购；亦为 YC 兼职合伙人。
Kat Mañalac — 合伙人；此前在 Y Combinator 任职十余年，负责创业项目与创始人社群。
Mike Trapanese — 合伙人，关注运营和战略资本；经历包括私募股权和企业运营。
Jay Ribakove — Principal；此前在 Munich Re Ventures 投资气候及建成环境风险领域公司。

milestones.description: 创始人 Bill Clerico 宣布第二期基金募集 8,500 万美元，并将投资主题由野火科技扩展到更广泛的灾害韧性。

track_record.description: 官网当前展示的组合案例包括 Burnbot（机器人燃料管理）、Gridware（电网保护）、Pano（野火早期探测）、Seneca（消防无人机）、Stand（韧性住房保险）与 The Lumber Manufactory；为精选展示，不代表完整组合或投资回报。
待校正的注册表关联：当前把 Convective 与 WindBorne Systems 的 2026 年 B 轮相连，但所附来源报道的是 2024 年 Series A；轮次和来源年份冲突，因此不将其作为 Convective 已核实投资。

public_profile.experience_summary: 管理团队披露的经历包括金融科技创业与并购、Y Combinator 创业者支持、私募股权运营以及气候和建成环境风险投资。

sources.source_title: Convective | Investing in a More Resilient World
sources.quote: Convective invests in hardware, software and financial services that manage risk in the physical world.

Prior to Convective, Bill was co-founder & CEO of WePay, a fintech company that was acquired by J.P. Morgan Chase in 2017, an angel investor in over 60 startups and a part-time partner at Y Combinator. … Previously, Kat spent more than a decade as a partner at Y Combinator, where she built programs and communities that helped thousands of founders scale their startups into companies worth billions. … Mike is a partner at Convective Capital focused on operations and strategic capital. Previously, Mike held diverse private equity and operating roles. … Prior to Convective, Jay was an investor at Munich Re Ventures, backing companies reducing risk in climate and the built environment.

Our companies protect the systems that keep the world running. … Robotic Fuels Management Burnbot Protecting the Grid Gridware Early Wildfire Detection Pano Firefighting Drones Seneca Insurance for Resilient Homes Stand Sawmills of the Future The Lumber Manufactory

sources.source_title: Fund II: $85M for Disaster Resilience | Bill Clerico
sources.quote: That’s why we’re excited to announce that we’ve raised $85M for our second fund. We’ll make a similar number of investments (~18) as in Fund I, but we’re writing bigger checks across pre-seed, seed and Series A and expanding our focus from wildfire to the disaster resilience market. … Updraft, our network of practitioners in the physical world, is now 10,000 people strong and has generated over $100M in revenue for our portfolio companies.
